title: An empirical evaluation of ACE-100 against its stated goals
note: Values here mirror what was registered and what the tools used during the Experiment 1 collection. They are recorded so a replication can read the settings instead of reading them out of tool source, and so a later experiment can differ without editing shared code. Changing a value here does NOT re-license a registered decision: the pre-registration governs.

target_repository.pinned_commit_note: per-task base commits live in manifest.json; the arm snapshot commit C is in audit/arm-gates/pinned.json

analysis.registered_statistic: within-task paired ratio (cost) / within-task paired delta (quality); see PREREGISTRATION.md section 7 and paper section 3.4 'Statistic discipline'

isolation.experiment_1_actual: workspace was a git worktree sharing the full clone's object store, and only the harness WebFetch/WebSearch tools were disabled; both channels leaked (see audit/network-sweep.json and paper section 7)
isolation.hardened_mode_available: run_cell.py --workspace-mode isolated (not used for Experiment 1; intended for the 1R replication)
